text:
Maya Patel: heads-up — support ticket from Brightdoc (tenant brightdoc-123). Customers seeing repeated 504s and very high tail p95 (~6s) starting ~17:55 PST. They say it started after a traffic spike from a nightly pipeline.
Raj Kumar: on it, can you paste the ticket id / any logs?
Maya Patel: ticket #T-98321. Support attached gateway logs showing a string of 504s and a couple of gateway timeouts. Example: `gateway: request_id=abc123 tenant=brightdoc-123 status=504 queue_wait_ms=4800 total_ms=5200`
Sam Ops: looking at infra: continuous-batcher queue for tenant brightdoc-123 spiked — queue_depth=3240, pending_batches=410. Our queue depth limiter hit `MAX_DEPTH=3000` and started early rejects, but a lot of requests stayed in queue and hit the request timeout.
Lucy Support: customer on hosted inference (not dedicated), model pinned to `gptx-8q`. They said traffic was low-high mix of short requests (30-200 tokens).
Raj Kumar: small-sequence heavy fanout is classic backlog cause — continuous batching groups many tiny requests into large batches, KV cache and kernel warmups amplify latency. Any quick mitigation?
Sam Ops: immediate mitigations we can try:
- disable continuous batching for tenant brightdoc-123
- lower per-tenant max_batch_size for that model to 32
- bump queue depth limit for this tenant temporarily to 6k (risky)
- enable early reject earlier (return 429) to avoid long tail timeouts
Maya Patel: can we toggle batching off for just this tenant? Customer would prefer fewer 5xxs over max throughput.
Raj Kumar: yes. Running the toggle now: `./tools/tenant_flags toggle --tenant brightdoc-123 --flag continuous_batching --value false`
deploy-bot: executed deploy: tenant-flag-change brightdoc-123 continuous_batching=false (change-id: cf-4520000123-1)
Sam Ops: seeing immediate change in metrics — queue_depth dropping from 3.2k -> 220 within 30s, pending_batches down to 8. p95 tail reduced from ~6s -> ~420ms.
Lucy Support: letting customer know we applied a temporary fix and will monitor.
Maya Patel: customer reported partial improvement, still a couple of 504s in last 10m. Asking for timeline and next steps.
Raj Kumar: follow-ups:
- short term: keep batching off for 1 hour and observe, maybe increase concurrency throttle for tenant by +25% if still needed.
- medium term: implement per-tenant batching profile (disable/limit continuous batching based on request size distribution), add a fast-path for tiny-seq fanout requests so they don't accumulate.
- long term: add dynamic queue-depth autosizing and better early-reject semantics (respond with 429 + Retry-After) to avoid 504s.
Sam Ops: opened infra ticket INF-2024 to add per-tenant batching caps and queue autosizing.
Maya Patel: documented repro steps in the support ticket: 1) generate 5k concurrent tiny requests (30-100 tokens) to hosted endpoint, 2) watch continuous-batcher queue depth grow, 3) observe gateway 504s once queue_wait > request_timeout.
Lucy Support: customer asked for ETA — can we commit to permanent change window?
Raj Kumar: scheduling a small change for tomorrow 02:00 UTC to add a per-tenant flag in the control plane UI and automated toggle in the CLI. I'll follow up in eng-runtime channel.
Maya Patel: thanks all — leaving batching disabled for now. Will update ticket and check back in 30m. :thumbsup:
